title: I enjoy flying ✈️ but airports are stressful 🛄 | Improve your listening with Real Easy English

sentences.en: Hi Becca.
sentences.ko: 안녕, 베카.

sentences.en: Hi Neil.
sentences.ko: 안녕, 닐.

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.ko: 잘 지내?

sentences.en: Have you got any trips coming up soon?
sentences.ko: 곧 여행 갈 일 있어?

sentences.en: I have. I'm going to Montenegro, which is exciting.
sentences.ko: 있어. 몬테네그로에 가는데, 신나.

sentences.en: I've never been there before, but it means that I have to go to an airport and I have to fly.
sentences.ko: 한 번도 가본 적 없는데, 그러려면 공항에 가서 비행기를 타야 하잖아.

sentences.en: I don't like flying.
sentences.ko: 나는 비행기 타는 게 싫어.

sentences.en: But we're talking about airports today in this episode of Real Easy English.
sentences.ko: 그런데 이번 Real Easy English에서는 공항에 대해 이야기할 거야.

sentences.en: We are. But people need to know that to get a transcript and a worksheet for this episode, they need to go to our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.ko: 맞아. 그런데 이번 에피소드의 대본과 워크시트를 받으려면 저희 웹사이트 bbclearningenglish.com으로 가셔야 해요.

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.ko: 물론이지.

sentences.en: So, you'll be going to an airport for your holiday, but what happens at an airport, Neil?
sentences.ko: 그러니까 휴가 때문에 공항에 갈 텐데, 공항에서는 무슨 일을 하지, 닐?

sentences.en: One of the most important things is check in.
sentences.ko: 가장 중요한 것 중 하나가 체크인이야.

sentences.en: Now, 'to check in' is to officially tell the airline that you're going to fly.
sentences.ko: 'check in'은 항공사에 비행기를 탈 거라고 공식적으로 알리는 거야.

sentences.en: Normally, now, we do this online, but you can still check in at the airport, I think.
sentences.ko: 요즘은 보통 온라인으로 하지만, 아직 공항에서도 체크인할 수 있는 것 같아.

sentences.en: Yes, you can. Yeah.
sentences.ko: 응, 할 수 있어.

sentences.en: So, there will be check-in gates.
sentences.ko: 그래서 체크인 카운터가 있지.

sentences.en: It is very important.
sentences.ko: 아주 중요해.

sentences.en: It is, because they give you a boarding pass then, don't they?
sentences.ko: 그렇지, 그때 탑승권을 주잖아, 그렇지?

sentences.en: They do.
sentences.ko: 맞아.

sentences.en: The boarding pass is the document that lets you get on the plane and also tells you what seat that you have on the plane as well.
sentences.ko: 탑승권(boarding pass)은 비행기에 탈 수 있게 해주는 서류고, 비행기에서 어느 좌석인지도 알려줘.

sentences.en: So, you've checked in and you've got your boarding pass.
sentences.ko: 그럼 체크인하고 탑승권을 받았어.

sentences.en: What happens next?
sentences.ko: 그다음엔 뭘 해?

sentences.en: Well, then you need to go through security, and that's when they check you to make sure you haven't got anything that you shouldn't have on a plane.
sentences.ko: 음, 그다음엔 보안 검색을 통과해야 해. 비행기에 가지고 타면 안 되는 물건이 없는지 확인하는 거야.

sentences.en: I hate airport security.
sentences.ko: 나는 공항 보안 검색이 정말 싫어.

sentences.en: Even though I know that I'm not carrying anything that I'm not supposed to have, it still makes me feel a bit stressed.
sentences.ko: 가지고 있으면 안 되는 걸 안 가지고 있다는 걸 알면서도, 여전히 좀 스트레스 받아.

sentences.en: Yeah, I know what you mean.
sentences.ko: 응, 무슨 말인지 알아.

sentences.en: You feel guilty even if you haven't done anything.
sentences.ko: 아무것도 안 했는데도 괜히 죄책감이 들지.

sentences.en: Exactly!
sentences.ko: 바로 그거야!

sentences.en: Yeah, airport security is one of the reasons I don't really enjoy airports.
sentences.ko: 응, 보안 검색은 내가 공항을 별로 안 좋아하는 이유 중 하나야.

sentences.en: Really? You don't like airports?
sentences.ko: 정말? 공항 안 좋아해?

sentences.en: I don't like airports.
sentences.ko: 공항 안 좋아해.

sentences.en: I enjoy flying but...
sentences.ko: 비행기 타는 건 좋은데...

sentences.en: yeah, airports can be a bit stressful for me.
sentences.ko: 응, 공항은 좀 스트레스 받아.

sentences.en: Well, I'm the exact opposite of you because I quite like airports, but I really don't like flying.
sentences.ko: 나는 너랑 완전 반대야. 공항은 꽤 좋아하는데, 비행기 타는 건 정말 싫어.

sentences.en: What do you like about airports?
sentences.ko: 공항의 어떤 점이 좋아?

sentences.en: I think because when you finally get to the airport, it's somebody else's problem for you to travel.
sentences.ko: 공항에 일단 도착하면, 그다음 이동은 다른 사람이 신경 쓸 문제니까 그런 것 같아.

sentences.en: So, it's my responsibility to get to the airport but once I'm there, I can relax.
sentences.ko: 그러니까 공항까지 가는 건 내 책임이지만, 일단 도착하면 마음 놓을 수 있어.

sentences.en: OK. And have you ever been in a situation where you relaxed a bit too much and almost missed a flight?
sentences.ko: 그렇구나. 그럼 너무 마음을 놓다가 비행기를 놓칠 뻔한 적은 있어?

sentences.en: Yes, I have missed a flight once and it was very stressful.
sentences.ko: 응, 한 번 비행기를 놓친 적이 있는데 엄청 스트레스였어.

sentences.en: I was travelling in Ireland and I had a flight in Dublin, and I was in a different city – in Cork.
sentences.ko: 아일랜드를 여행 중이었는데, 더블린에서 비행기를 타야 했고 나는 다른 도시인 코크에 있었어.

sentences.en: And I missed the train from Cork to Dublin and so I couldn't get to the airport on time.
sentences.ko: 그런데 코크에서 더블린 가는 기차를 놓쳐서 제시간에 공항에 못 갔어.

sentences.en: So, you did miss that flight?
sentences.ko: 그래서 그 비행기를 놓쳤어?

sentences.en: I missed it.
sentences.ko: 놓쳤어.

sentences.en: Oh no!
sentences.ko: 아이고!

sentences.en: So, Becca, have you ever missed a flight?
sentences.ko: 베카, 너는 비행기 놓친 적 있어?

sentences.en: Thankfully, no, I haven't missed a flight.
sentences.ko: 다행히 비행기를 놓친 적은 없어.

sentences.en: I was very close to missing a flight...
sentences.ko: 놓칠 뻔한 적은 있어...

sentences.en: I was just relaxing.
sentences.ko: 그냥 쉬고 있었거든.

sentences.en: I had travelled from Vietnam and I was really tired, so I wasn't really listening carefully.
sentences.ko: 베트남에서 오는 길이라 너무 피곤해서 안내 방송을 제대로 안 듣고 있었어.

sentences.en: Well, they didn't call my name, so I was really stressed trying to find the gate, but luckily I caught it.
sentences.ko: 내 이름을 부르진 않았지만, 탑승구 찾느라 엄청 스트레스 받았는데 다행히 탔어.

sentences.en: I think I was the last person to board the plane, and that's always a little bit embarrassing as well.
sentences.ko: 아마 마지막으로 탑승한 사람이었을 거야. 그것도 항상 좀 민망하지.

sentences.en: You know what, Becca?
sentences.ko: 있잖아, 베카?

sentences.en: I think if you get your name read out on the loudspeaker in an airport, that's really embarrassing because everyone in the airport is thinking, Who's that person?
sentences.ko: 공항 스피커로 내 이름이 불리면 정말 창피할 것 같아. 공항에 있는 모두가 '저 사람 누구야?' 하고 생각하잖아.

sentences.en: That person who's going to miss their flight!
sentences.ko: 비행기 놓치게 생긴 저 사람!

sentences.en: And you don't want to be that person.
sentences.ko: 그런 사람이 되고 싶진 않지.

sentences.en: OK. Becca, it's time to recap the vocabulary that we used in this episode, starting with 'check in'.
sentences.ko: 좋아. 베카, 이번 에피소드에서 쓴 어휘를 복습할 시간이야. 먼저 'check in'.

sentences.en: 'Check in' is the verb, which means you officially tell the plane company that you plan to get on the plane, and you give them your bags as well.
sentences.ko: 'Check in'은 동사인데, 항공사에 비행기에 탈 계획이라고 공식적으로 알리고 짐도 맡기는 걸 뜻해.

sentences.en: And at the airport you do this at the check-in desk.
sentences.ko: 공항에서는 체크인 카운터(check-in desk)에서 해.

sentences.en: Yes. And at the check-in desk, that's where you get your boarding pass, and that's the ticket that you need to get on the plane.
sentences.ko: 맞아. 그리고 체크인 카운터에서 탑승권을 받는데, 비행기에 타려면 꼭 필요한 표야.

sentences.en: And then we heard the expression 'go through security'.
sentences.ko: 그다음엔 'go through security'라는 표현을 들었지.

sentences.en: If you go through security, you go through that area where they check and make sure you have nothing with you that should not be on a plane.
sentences.ko: 'go through security'는 비행기에 있으면 안 되는 물건이 없는지 확인하는 구역을 통과하는 거야.

sentences.en: Yes. Going through security – my least favourite thing about airports.
sentences.ko: 맞아. 보안 검색 통과하기, 공항에서 내가 제일 싫어하는 거.

sentences.en: After security, you wait at the boarding gate and this is the area that you wait at before you get on the plane.
sentences.ko: 보안 검색이 끝나면 탑승구(boarding gate)에서 기다리는데, 비행기에 타기 전에 기다리는 곳이야.

sentences.en: If you catch a flight, it means you successfully get on the plane and fly somewhere, but if you miss a flight, like I did in Ireland, it means that you were too late to get on the plane.
sentences.ko: 'catch a flight'는 비행기를 제대로 타고 어딘가로 가는 거고, 내가 아일랜드에서 그랬던 것처럼 'miss a flight'는 너무 늦어서 비행기를 못 탔다는 뜻이야.

sentences.en: Well, Neil, that's it for this week's episode of Real Easy English, but we'll be back next week with another episode.
sentences.ko: 닐, 이번 주 Real Easy English는 여기까지고, 다음 주에 새 에피소드로 돌아올게요.

sentences.en: Don't forget that you can download a free worksheet on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.ko: 웹사이트 bbclearningenglish.com에서 무료 워크시트를 받을 수 있다는 것도 잊지 마세요.

sentences.en: Goodbye for now.
sentences.ko: 그럼 이만.

sentences.en: Bye!
sentences.ko: 안녕!
